[[File:Life_Day_Wreath.png|thumb|205px|A Life Day Wreath]]
A '''Life Day Wreath''' was an arrangement of branches and artificial lights in the rough shape of a circle that was used for decoration on [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The use of Life Day Wreaths was common during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
